description.p: Bring music from your servers and local folders into one library, with built-in Discord and Last.fm integration

ul.li: Can connect to multiple Jellyfin, Subsonic, Navidrome servers as well as multiple local folders, and can seamlessly switch between them
Built-in Last.fm, Libre.fm, and ListenBrainz scrobbling
Discord Rich Presence
Automatic lyrics/cover art lookup
Smart playlists that support multiple combinations
And other music player basics

description.p: Another quick release for QoL improvements.

ul.li: Basic now playing indicator for list views is added, if you play a song with double-click, or through play in context menu now that song is highlighted
Shuffle was fixing the track it picks for long lists. Now if you click the top play button in a page, or through play icon grid view it doesn't just pick the same song over and over again
Added German translations by sevachka
Added play buttons to genre detail page
Bigger image view on album and artist pages had black background regardless of theme, now they follow theme color
Preferences popup now opens instantly, instead of taking 1s~
Menu now closes itself when it opens preferences pop-up
Fixed an issue where buttons on grids and pages could show artifacts
Several alignment fixes for buttons and text

description.p: A quick hotfix.

ul.li: Removing topbar made app window not draggable. Now it is draggable again, and from more areas: top area, sidebar, and bottom player

description.p: This release fixes some artifacts that appear on artist and album pages, please report if you can still reproduce.

ul.li: Moved menu icon to sidebar, and moved server selector inside to menu
Adjusted the expensive path track/Album radio was taking, causing 10-18s delay to queue. It is now almost instant

description.p: This release is mostly fixing the rough edges for Navidrome/Subsonic servers.

ul.li: Made the onboarding/adding new server experience better, cover arts are cached much faster
Radio icon is now symbolic, therefore it will be theme-aware
Audio output names now use actual device names. You can also change your audio device directly with a button on the bottom, without needing to navigate to preferences
Adressed an issue with Jellyfin servers where rarely on cold launches there could be 4-6s delay to play the first song
Album/artist pages can now show navidrome server links as well
Server management screen becomes more compact
Added a button to force resync folders

Fixed a Navidrome/Subsonic issue about initial cover art caching. Normally for Jellyfin, Rufin only caches cover arts per album, and reuses it, but this didn't work as intended in other servers, especially since Subsonic can serve different cover arts for same album tracks
Fixed an issue where Auto DJ could do more work than it needed, causing small freezes in UI if songs are skipped rapidly
Fixed a bug about where in-progress sync could prevent server switching

description.p: This release brings support for server owned song APIs! These mean you can now access radios for track/album/artist/playlist and so on from the context menu, and Auto DJ also uses this automatically.

ul.li: We have a new button in context menus and our pages, radio, which uses Jellyfin's Instant Mix or Navidrome/Subsonic equivalents. This also means your Jellyfin plugins that affect recommendations now work
Add the required notification permission to show track covers in OS notifications
Reworked server adding dialog, and local folder is now hidden from the selection dialog if no local folder is configured
If artist ID is missing from music server, Rufin still tries to merge it from MusicBrainz ID, this is a strict fallback and dropped when the track gets a proper ID
Fixed a regression with sync progress not changing in toast notification, and removed sliding animation for control buttons
Fixed several issues with localization
Fixed an issue where initial local folder scan had UI stuck despite scan finishing
Added a debug only stress test flag that you can run Rufin with multiplying your local library, for fun and further optimization purposes (details at github)

description.p: Big visual overhaul! The biggest change is that we got rid of the mostly empty topbar, which came with a lot of other changes. I spent great effort in making app behave saner in different window sizes. Additionally, I'm experimenting with newer visual features.

ul.li: Removed back/forward keys from sidebar and added them to detail pages (album, playlist, and so on) to make it easier, which also works in small screens
Bottom player got further tweaks to keep it consistent
Artist pages and smart playlist lists are now faster to load
Lyrics now don't highlight any lines if next line is empty (#281) and lyrics header spacing got tigthened
Detail pages keep their layout more consistently
If artist ID is missing from music server, Rufin still tries to merge it from MusicBrainz ID, this is a strict fallback and dropped when the track gets a proper ID
Fixed a regression with sync progress not changing in toast notification, and removed sliding animation for control buttons
Fixed several issues with localization

description.p: Quick hotfix for scrollbar and missing locale selection

I believe this release makes the app much more predictable after adressing common UX gaps and making it viable in smaller window sizes. Since Rufin got a lot of changes in last 3 versions, new issues for possible regressions are appreciated.

ul.li: Added Russian and Latvian translations by Александр Стельмах
App window now can be made smaller, to 450x400 px
Added release and control button toast notifications, these can be controlled from preferences
Added more keyboard shortcuts
Lyrics loading is faster now, and fixed another NetEase placeholder text

Queue and playback behavior got several fixes: clearing the queue now keeps the current track while removing the rest (#247), shuffle uses the full source list, the current queue track stays visible, MPRIS updates are now not lagging behind and Auto DJ doesn't create an entry per skip and create a delay on continous skips
Local and cached library handling got better, and fixed a bug where local library kept the deleted tracks
Fixed a bug that longer titles and albums could push the bottom player buttons to the right

description.p: This release touches a lot of areas, and fixes 2 biggest problems of the app: UI freezes on playing/skipping, and unreliable window resize reactions. There were a lot of improvements in playback thanks to this and solving these 2 problems will make the future easier. There are several improvements and bug fixes in other areas as well:

ul.li: Context menu got reworked, and now can also be accessed by long press or touchscreen hold
Albums and playlists now have most common 2 genres show up as pills
Source select menu now lies inside app window at all sizes
Showcase card doesn't have rough edges anymore, and grids/gradients have shadows on their edges
Add to playlist is no longer the boring submenu, but it now opens a powerful popup where you can create a playlist, add to multiple playlists at once and decide to skip duplicates
Playlists now have an index, so they are faster to load
Toast notifications now use custom style. Server resync button gives progress as a toast notification.
On artist and album pages clicking artwork now opens it on a bigger view
Audio fades on clicking play/pause to create a more immersive experience, can be disabled from configs
Queue items are now re-orderable by dragging
UI feedback for favorite action is now instant
Bottom player is now updated immediately on track changes
Play/pause and other buttons on cards now react on hover

Solved an edge case where an album without a cover on Jellyfin and on Rufin (MusicBrainz fetch) showed a stale art despite Jellyfin using the artist cover as fallback. Rufin also does this now, while still respecting to Jellyfin source
Adjusted minimal window size to have song titles to be shown as much as it can, and adjusted equalizer to fit to the fullscreen player properly
Fixed the momentarily UI freeze on song playing and or playing a new track, which also fixed the case where repeteadly skipping songs stacked these freezes
Fixed several bugs in queue about rendering, scroll setting not being applied
Fixed a regression that equalizer settings were only applied on next app launch
Fixed a bug that visualizer would not show up for the current song in some conditions
Fixed a bug where albums page in detail view crashed the app

description.p: More UI polish, and now you can use system keyring for saved secrets, changeable from Preferences, under Privacy & Security.

ul.li: Improved text highlights to make them more readable
Detail pages now show the real release type, so EPs and singles no longer appear as Album in the header
Library and detail views got reworked: Album page now uses larger grids, titles stay to one line, and action buttons/hover controls are more consistent

description.p: A lot of minor bug fixes; overall performance and visual polish.

ul.li: Reworked left sidebar
Album artist tab now groups artists based on tags/MusicBrainz IDs
Made context menu open instantly
Added triple dot to bottom player and hover cards to access context menu easier
Removed a lot of unnecassary library lookups that improves app speed overall
Fixed a bug where grid covers were discarded on scroll and had to be waited to load again
Fixed a bug with NetEase lyrics where it wrote an empty lyrics file
Fixed a bug lyrics panel height preference was not persisted

description.p: This is a hotfix release for bugs that got introduced with the last release.

ul.li: Changed to a new visualizer and fixed a bug where it made heavier file formats crash the app
Improved local CUE library handling, startup/search/track-route paths avoid some expensive work that could make the app hang with CUE-heavy folders
Added an option to prefer server-provided playlist covers, while keeping Rufin’s generated playlist covers as the default behavior
Reduced the workload for queue building
Improved warm remote startup sync behavior, and fixed the startup freeze
Also updated Rust version to 1.95

description.p: Thanks for everyone's patience, we fixed some critical bugs this release, which had to wait since there were so many things to test as well, given the size of the release:

ul.li: Added release type groups on artist pages, so albums, EPs, singles, collections and appears-on releases are no longer mixed together
Added CUE support for local libraries. CUE tracks are split into playable tracks
Added more external lyrics providers, configurable from preferences
Added external site links on album and artist pages for Last.fm, MusicBrainz and the current music sever, toggleable
Improved album and artist detail layouts especially for resizing, and repaired several equalizer/fullscreen controls
Reworked library identity and metadata handling, fixing cases where local tags or sort fields could create duplicate or wrong artist entries

Made cover art selection and readiness across startup, routes, queue, playback and fullscreen player, so cached or resolvable covers should no longer fall back to placeholders easily, gated by a policy
Added mouse back/forward button navigation
Fixed a bug lyrics panel height didn't respect user preference
Fixed queue/player artwork mismatches where one track from an album could show fallback art while track already had the cover
Fixed several bugs where high bitrate remote tracks crashed the app or the player
Fixed a bug where layout gets calculated repeatadly while resizing pages, causing high CPU usage

description.p: Thanks to everyone who reported issues again. We got to fix several bugs & unwanted behavior this release!

ul.li: Added fullscreen player visualizer and equalizer tabs
Made genres and playlists load instantly like other routes
Expanded equalizer to have Winamp-like presets
Smoothed fullscreen player open/close animation
Improved route layout stability for different window sizes
Fixed a bug where fullscreen player made the app window not draggable
Fixed a bug where playing a later track in the queue froze the app
Fixed a bug where longer playlists and genres showed a blank screen mid-scroll
Fixed a bug smart playlist page turned blank after scrolling
Made artist/album columns expand to see the full text if there is enough space
Made column entries start from where column header starts, so they look like a proper table now

description.p: Made app more responsive for smaller window sizes, and fixed a bug where page content disappear Added type-to-search like GTK apps to main routes, can be disabled from preferences Fixed a bug where smart playlist content did not update

ul.li: Fixed a bug where UI stayed stale during syncing library even though sync has finished
Removed duplicate "Caching library" wording
Moved local folder mapping for server library under a toggle

description.p: The heaviest release so far, a lot of fundamentals have changed for the better, thanks everyone reporting issues! There was a compatability problem with using the keyring, which caused issues for several systems, therefore we migrated to a local storage. This unfortunately means that you will need to login again to your servers, and enter API credentials again, but this is an one-time thing. I hope the improvements make up for this inconvenience:

ul.li: Improved local library caching with visible scan/metadata progress and smarter handling of artworks, which reduces the initial scan time greatly
Adapted a shared cover caching model, this dramatically reduces repeated cover lookups when navigation routes as well as memory usage
Library changes are applied smartly, app only tries to do the minimal required database changes
Added Weblate link for translations
Added Estonian translation (Priit Jõerüüt)
Fixed several bugs for lyrics fetching that made the section look stale
Favorites now load from the saved library cache
Library and home content can now update without forcing a full page reload
Made the app store tokens as base64 in case secret service is not available
Added required system tray permission for the flatpak
Added incremental library scans, rescans are now more efficient
Library sync now detects changes more precisely

description.p: This has been a fruitful release, got to make pages more consistent with the app UI, and fix a lot of bugs thanks to people reporting on Github. There is more optimization for caching, and QoL I'm working on, so stay tuned!

ul.li: Redesigned artist, album and playlists pages
Added an option to close the app to tray, and added multimedia controls to tray icon
Added in-app toast notifications for server auth
Playing notification now correctly shows the the album artwork
Queue is now kept alive, it no longer refreshes and jumps to first entry on clicking one item
Fixed an issue sidebar icons were not showing up in flatpak
Initial caching screen now reports progress
Fixed a bug where items got buried under the right sidebar, or pushed the right sidebar out of the window
Fixed a bug that automatic lyrics fetching could fetch lyrics just based on song names
Fixed a bug that shuffle relied on a stagnant queue
Fixed a bug that causes app to crash during smart playlist creation
Reworked lyrics search to it work reliably for any query

description.p: This is another big release, with wide range of bug fixes and performance improvements, specifically for local folders. I'm thankful to all the people who submitted issues. We now have smart playlists. You can combine different rules as well. Currently this is WIP, there can be more work to do on this. You can change the regular seekbar with waveform one. Waveforms are calculated lazily based on the queue to not throttle the performance. Implemented a wider range of Auto DJ features.
This is a big release, workflows of the repository are hardened and automatized further.

ul.li: Fixed a bug where home page refreshes needlessly.
Made server connection more robust, added timeouts/size limits to prevent unnecassary hangs
Refactored secret storage keys, scrobbling keys are also in secret storage now.

description.p: -Added support for translations - Created CONTRIBUTING.md - Fixed Jellyfin timeout issue for native builds
Fix Flathub app icon sizing.
Restore Native music client summary.
Restore Discord Rich Presence reliability and MPRIS artwork updates
This is Rufin's initial Flathub release. Discord Rich Presence now requests access only to the IPC socket instead of the full Discord folder.
Fixed version detection in packaged builds.
Fixed Flatpak keyring reconnect handling so saved credentials reconnect more reliably.
Added a fullscreen player. Restored album artwork, row context menus, artist cover fallbacks, and portal-backed secrets for Flatpak builds.
Reduced cover art cache memory growth. Large libraries should use less memory during navigation.
Improved library loading and scrolling responsiveness. Artwork lookup now blocks first-run navigation less and retries external cover misses after Last.fm changes.
Moved cache data to XDG cache locations and separated app cache paths. Fixed local library setup, cover caching, window geometry persistence, and duplicate local genre covers.
Refined playback controls, media context menus, playlist views, and library navigation. Improved route scrolling, sidebar alignment, cover alignment, and playback defaults.

Added unified source selection for servers and local folders, path mapping for local playback, and draggable customization for sidebar and home sections. Improved first-run login, home refreshes, and source settings.
Added scrobbling account connection flows and a daily update prompt. Improved metadata and artwork lookup, local playback matching, adaptive layout stability, lyrics handling, and sidebar behavior.
Added built-in scrobbling for external services. Refined album details, restored window sizing, and updated packaging metadata.
Added local playback support and improved playback behavior. Library pages now append more rows during browsing, and local folder management is easier to use.
Added Subsonic streaming support, Jellyfin server discovery, Discord Rich Presence, and configurable library layouts. Improved search, lyrics lookup, and Flatpak packaging.
Added cached Jellyfin home sections and improved right-panel queue search. Refined route headers, compact layouts, table links, and lyrics behavior.
Improved album card sizing, player controls, queue behavior, lyrics scrolling, and responsive navigation.
Initial preview with a native GTK shell, Jellyfin login, cached library browsing, and GStreamer playback.
